# Recorded SAP AI Core responses

These files are copied unchanged from the `test-util/data/foundation-models/` directory of
[SAP/ai-sdk-js](https://github.com/SAP/ai-sdk-js), the SAP Cloud SDK for AI (JavaScript).

They are recordings of real SAP AI Core foundation-model (Azure OpenAI dialect) responses and are
used here to play back the wire format offline.
